title: Mali's First Day
topic: ชีวิตนักเรียน
lines: Mali moved to Bangkok with her family last month. Her father got a new
job there, so they had to leave their small town in the north. On her
first day at the new school, Mali felt very nervous. **She** did not know
anyone, and the school was five times bigger than her old one.
In the morning, a girl called Fai sat next to her in the math class.
Fai smiled and asked where she was from. When Mali told **her**, Fai was
excited. Her grandmother lived in the same town! At lunch, Fai took Mali
to the canteen and introduced her to two friends. **They** were in the
school band, and they asked Mali to join. Mali had played the drums at
her old school, so she said yes immediately.
After school, Mali called her old best friend. "I was afraid of **this**
day," she said, "but now I think I will be happy here."
